Card Q&A.a: Yes. Both effects activate, so you can draw a total of 2 cards.
Card Q&A.q: I have 2 Digimon with this card in their digivolution cards in my battle area, and a card is removed from my security stack. Do the inherited effects on both Digimon activate, activating  twice and drawing me 2 cards?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
